steps.label: foreign-parent
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE other_schema.referenced_table(id INT64 NOT NULL,unique_val INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(id)

steps.label: foreign-unique
steps.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX other_schema.referenced_unique ON other_schema.referenced_table(unique_val)

steps.label: foreign-child-1
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE referring_table_1(id INT64 NOT NULL,ref_val INT64 NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT fk_ref_1 FOREIGN KEY(ref_val) REFERENCES other_schema.referenced_table(unique_val) NOT ENFORCED) PRIMARY KEY(id)

steps.label: foreign-child-2
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE referring_table_2(id INT64 NOT NULL,ref_val INT64 NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT fk_ref_2 FOREIGN KEY(ref_val) REFERENCES other_schema.referenced_table(unique_val) NOT ENFORCED) PRIMARY KEY(id)

steps.label: foreign-join
steps.sql: SELECT rc.constraint_name,tc.table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS rc JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc ON tc.constraint_catalog=rc.unique_constraint_catalog AND tc.constraint_schema=rc.unique_constraint_schema AND tc.constraint_name=rc.unique_constraint_name WHERE rc.constraint_name='fk_ref_1'
